rubric_notes: Verified facts: release 2.08, lineage sunids, five families with full protein lists matching children evidence, single superfamily under a.22, homology endpoint (homology_implied_by_level true, scope sf, no warnings) and empty annotations. Interpretation by level is correct and explicitly limited: superfamily placement does not imply same function, TAFs/NC2/NF-Y/CHRAC are not nucleosome histones, no inference of DNA-binding mode or oligomeric state, domains not whole proteins, and different placement of name matches is not proof of non-relatedness. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All identifiers and classifications match the bundle. Superfamily-level remote homology interpreted correctly, more distant than family, no implied pairwise sequence similarity; rejects HisE/MazG function transfer, templates, quantitative claims, orthology, oligomer state. Minor imprecision in saying superfamily rests partly on sequence evidence, not material. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Families c.55.1.1/53068, c.55.1.3/53083, c.55.1.4/53089 under c.55.1/53067 and lineage are bundle-supported; the sccs lookups returning species nodes are honestly described. Correct superfamily-level remote homology and conserved two-lobed ATP-binding core; rejects transfer of substrate, reaction, function, ligand specificity, mechanism and template use; fold-level correctly treated as structural similarity only. Does not address the gold-named regulation or oligomeric-state limits. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Hierarchy, SUNIDs, example domains, superfamily comment ('contains bimetal-ion centre in the middle of the bundle'), and absence of homology warnings are all supported by the bundle. Correct divergent-evolution reading, explicit refusal to infer iron storage, radical generation, or catalase activity from superfamily placement, and states that family-level placement, active-site ligands, and experiments are required. Clearly separates SCOPe-derived facts from background chemistry. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All sunids, domains, boundaries (5n0y A:3-112), annotations (including the empty d1ikop_ comment list) and homology responses are in the bundle and quoted accurately. Correctly contrasts same-superfamily probable homology with the different-superfamily no-assertion case, rejects copper-site/redox/template transfer, names required evidence, and states retrieval limits. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy; extra identifiers (Ubiquitin protein 54238, c-Raf1 RBD 54264, d3by4b_, d3a9ja_, Pfam PF00240/PF00789/PF00788/PF02196, sf and family homology flags) all supported by bundle. Superfamily as homology-bearing assertion with reusable scaffold, family vs superfamily distinction, benchmark-design implication; rejects function/partner/mechanism transfer, template reuse, fold-only ancestry, and over-reading absence of warnings.

All classifications, sunids and the d1m2ea_ (78478) lineage, 'CASP5' comment and no-warning homology response are supported; stable-release label supported; transparent that the ODC placement came from the superfamily children listing. Reasoning: shared superfamily supports probable common origin of a CheY-like doubly wound a/b domain, more distant than within-family; rejects phosphorylatable receiver/two-component role, decarboxylase or PLP catalysis in the wing, KaiC-stimulating clock role, template/substrate/pathway transfer, and 'analogous/convergent' claims; notes KaiA's activity is tied to its other domain. Does not misplace ODC catalysis. No material issues. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Verified facts (b.84.5/310577, b.84.5.1/310616, protein nodes, example domains with boundaries, five superfamilies, no homology flags, PubMed) all in bundle. Twofold claim stated correctly: V1/A1 bulge domains homologous within the family/superfamily; fold similarity to other hybrid superfamilies not accepted as homology evidence; separate superfamilies do not show analogy. Minor loose phrasing that fold grouping reflects 'possibly sequence or functional' similarity, but not relied on. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All cited facts (release 2.08 and periodic update, class f sunid 56835, fold 81344 and comment, three superfamily sunids, children has_more=false, fold homology warning with no heterogeneity/repeat flags) are supported by the bundle. States that only family and superfamily carry homology assertions, that separate superfamilies do not show the groups are unrelated or convergent, that a negative claim needs independent structural/sequence/phylogenetic evidence, and rejects function/heme/redox/template transfer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Fully supported: lineage, three families with sunids, family and superfamily homology records (no warnings/heterogeneity), and annotation comments. Correctly uses the c.2.1.1 comment 'N-terminal all-beta domain defines family' to show family assignment depends on partner-domain context, and the c.2.1.9 Pfam PF02254 mapping as automated, not functional proof. Superfamily = probable common ancestry, families = divergence; rejects transfer of substrate, cofactor specificity, catalytic activity, regulatory mechanism and template use; notes absence of warning is not proof of homology and different superfamily would not prove analogy. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Meets all must_include items: same family k.40.1.1 (sunid 100905), explicit 'not a true family' comment retrieved from the family annotations endpoint, and the calibrated conclusion that the shared placement is a designed structural grouping that does not carry the usual family-level homology inference. Correctly notes homology_implied_by_level is generic and overridden, refuses to assert analogy or independent origin, declines function/template transfer, and states limits (no sequence/structure comparison). All identifiers and lineage match the evidence bundle.

Verified 1.69 (d1t1ja_ c.137.1.1 singleton fold vs d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1) and 2.08 (d1t1ja1 c.23.14.2 and d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1 under shared c.23.14) lineages with sunids. Correctly describes the change as a move from different fold to shared superfamily (probable common ancestry) while families stay distinct, notes retained sunids, l.1.1.1 artifacts, and limits on function/template transfer and rationale.

Full class l lineage with sunids supported by parents endpoint; d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 sunid 20061 supported by pdb domains list; homology warning quoted correctly. Correctly explains class l family/superfamily/fold labels are not evolutionary groupings, notes 8-residue match is low information, and states limits. Extra d1a14l_/d1a14n_ facts are bundle-supported. All must_include met, no must_avoid violation.

Complete: single d1acca_ through 2.03, split first appearing in 2.04 and persisting to 2.08, new sunids distinct from the old f.11 nodes. Strong module reasoning, no positive homology asserted between the two different-class domains, and careful per-domain search and benchmark advice.

Complete domain list with sunids, boundaries and lineages, all supported; correct new-fold identification and mosaic inference with explicit caveats on function, nonhomology, and acquisition timing. Internally inconsistent on the bromodomain: correctly notes placement in the Bromodomain family, then states all four related domains 'have their own Prp8-specific family'. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge, 2026-10-22.

All must_include items met: shared family with full lineage and sunids, repeat-unit basis for length variation, 're' flag on d2kq5a_/d3v6pa_, 'single repeat' comment, canonical repeat 4cj9 A:259-292 with correct coordinate-scope caveat. Honest about not retrieving lengths; appropriate limits on specificity and template transfer.

Reports 2.08 / 2.08-stable and periodic 2.08-2026-08-16 with correct dates (bundle-supported). Correctly recommends citing the stable release with release-scoped 2.08 selector, and recording the periodic label as additional provenance rather than a replacement. States periodic is an interim update that does not replace stable. Omits the content meaning of the periodic label (adds newly classified PDB entries without rewriting older stable domains), explicitly declining to infer it. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. All verified facts (domain lists, sunids, lineage, protein/species nodes, fragment comment, 'ms' flag, homology output) match the bundle, with explicit scoping of unretrieved chains. Correctly reads the fragment fold call as 'observed part resembles a spectrin-repeat-like element' rather than the complete fold, makes 1dn1 B the evidence for complete architecture, keeps fold-level similarity separate from superfamily/family homology, and restricts fragment use for boundaries, templates and function. Minor imprecision that family is the 'strongest relationship' SCOPe records is not material.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Fully conceptual but complete: divergence at family/superfamily, possible convergence across folds without asserting it from SCOPe silence, correct reading of fold vs superfamily semantics, and a clear list of what evidence a homology (or convergence) claim needs. No must_avoid violations. Factual: no identifiers or release facts cited (explicitly stated), no errors; support is therefore adequate but thin.

Full, correct classifications with SUNIDs (89260/89261/49796/267607/267633/267693), 2.04 different folds b.23 vs b.18, 2.08 same superfamily b.18.1 with separate families. Frames as superfamily-level probable common ancestry, cites structural resemblance to delta-endotoxin C-terminal domain and divergent function, rejects function/template transfer. Complete.

Release details, lineage with sunids, boundaries, comments, hf definition/scope, and homology endpoint output all supported. Homology retained; 3-helical-bundle geometry explicitly not justified for d1ztra1; template, label-noise, leakage, and mutant/ligand-state caveats; recommends exclude/stratify/label separately with caveat preserved; clearly lists what was not checked (coordinates, RMSD, ASTRAL quality, history). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge, 2026-10-22.

Complete. All sunids, boundaries, fr annotation (domain-level, non-inherited, in heterogeneity), comment, homology_implied_by_level and quality values supported by bundle. Homology retained; truncation-driven low coverage/RMSD not read as divergence; fragment excluded or stratified as representative; quality explicitly not used to override fr; diversity at protein/species level; function and ligand (cr9) not transferred. Limits well stated, including that absence of fr on d1uc6a1 is not proof of completeness. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Correct recommendation; family is a positive, closer homology claim; new superfamily is a two-part structural plus 'no ancestry assertion' claim, not a finding of unrelatedness, revisable; new fold only for genuine core topology difference; two-stage decision procedure (topology match, then ancestry evidence threshold) integrating sequence, motif, function and architecture; checks boundaries/fragment caveats; hits not homology evidence. No fabricated identifiers. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct 2.08 lineage and sunids for the three families under d.144.1; current-release call, per-family parent lineages, homology record and annotation comment are all supported by the bundle. Justifies superfamily-level common ancestry and a conserved ATP/Mg phosphoryl-transfer scaffold while labelling mechanistic detail as non-API background, explicitly denies substrate, reaction, specificity and regulation transfer and notes 'no warning' is not positive evidence. Evidence list covers within-family closeness, structure-based alignment, complex structures, domain/regulatory context, biochemistry and phylogeny. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.
